templates.listingDisclosure: Important HOA requirement: This condominium is located in Example Condominium and occupancy is subject to condominium association / HOA approval before check-in. After booking, guests must promptly complete the required HOA lease/application paperwork, follow the association's secure Tenant Evaluation vendor process, review the Rules and Regulations, and follow the HOA fee instructions. Sensitive identity or screening material must go only to the association's designated vendor, never to this application. Check-in/access information cannot be released until the HOA / Board approval has been received. Delayed or incomplete paperwork may make the stay impossible under the condominium rules.
templates.airbnbInitialMessage:
Hi {{firstName}},

thank you for your booking request/reservation for {{unit}} from {{start}} to {{end}}.

Important HOA step: Example Condominium requires a lease/application package and HOA/Board approval before occupancy. I will send you the HOA paperwork and the association's secure Tenant Evaluation vendor instructions by email. Please complete the Lease Application and signed Short-Term Lease Agreement promptly. Send any sensitive identity or screening material only through the association's designated secure vendor channel, never by reply email or through this application.

The HOA application fee must be handled as instructed by the association: {{fee}}.

I cannot release check-in or access information until the HOA / Board approval is received. Please confirm that you understand this HOA requirement and tell me the best email address for the non-sensitive coordination paperwork.

Best,
Owner
templates.airbnbReminder:
Hi {{firstName}},

quick reminder: I have not yet received the completed HOA paperwork for your {{start}} stay.

Please send the completed and signed documents by {{deadlineDocuments}}, so I can submit everything to the condominium association in time.

Important: I cannot release check-in/access information until Example Condominium / the HOA Board has approved the application.

Please confirm today or tomorrow when you will send the documents.

Best,
Owner
templates.firmDeadline:
Hi {{firstName}},

I need to set a firm deadline for the HOA paperwork.

Example Condominium requires HOA/Board approval before occupancy, and I cannot provide check-in or access information without that approval.

Please complete the following by {{deadlineDocuments}}:

- Lease Application
- signed Short-Term Lease Agreement
- secure Tenant Evaluation vendor handoff and vendor confirmation

Sensitive identity or screening material must go only to the association's designated secure vendor channel, never by reply email or through this application. The USD 100 HOA application fee must also be mailed by check or money order as previously explained.

If the required coordination documents and vendor confirmation are not complete by this deadline, I will need to contact Airbnb because the reservation may not be possible under the HOA requirements.

Best,
Owner
templates.submittedToHoa:
Hi {{firstName}},

I have submitted your HOA application package to the condominium association / management office. We are now waiting for HOA/Board approval.

I will update you as soon as approval is received. Check-in details will be released only after approval.

Best,
